findings.S61: closeCompanyUnits builds a candidate State for each connected group and only publishes it after all group-owner consolidations succeed. Failure discards the candidate, marks that group blocked, and preserves previously successful independent groups.
findings.S62: QuickTaskSearch uses a list of native buttons; it no longer exposes listbox/option semantics or false aria-selected state. Selection opens an authorized task without changing the actor.
findings.S63: The shared Dialog captures the opener, conditionally restores focus when closing, supports a visible fallback, and lets QuickTaskSearch suppress restoration when selection intentionally transfers focus to the task destination.
findings.S64: Backup validation and UI language describe the 50 MB limit as applying to the complete backup, including data and files; v1 compatibility and individual evidence limits remain.
findings.S65: Evidence commits distinguish committed, definitely rejected, and unknown outcomes. Fresh evidence is compensated only after confirmed rejection; ambiguous or post-commit failures retain referenced files and expose recovery information. Operational and deliverable evidence paths both have regressions.
